messages.text: INV-057 (Rs.93,000) is 44 days overdue — please respond, this has been outstanding a long time.
Apologies for the delay. We will process Rs.93,000 by this Friday without fail.
Following up — Friday's date passed without payment landing, could you update us?
Sorry, ran into an unexpected issue. Will process it early next week instead.
To be safe, let's say Rs.93,000 by next Wednesday.
